comment: Per-state grade from the lighting bible (docs/proposals/look-fix-v1/LOOK-FIX-SPEC.md §2.2). luma: the whole-frame mean display brightness (Y8, 0-255, the look loop's measure) the auto exposure aims for; saturation: the post-process saturation multiplier, tuned on the iPhone toward the bible's mean saturation (scripts/lighting_bible.py; the bible's S target follows in each entry for reference). air: the §2.3 clear-air fade (start m, d50 m where it reaches half the cap, cap, colour); rain, storm, fog, smoke, haze and dust set the cap to 0 because their weather extinction (§3.2, weather.json fog distances) takes over. direct: a renderer multiplier on the weather model's direct sun, tuned toward the bible's key:fill and lift (§2.2-2.3: overcast lift 0.78-0.88, rain 0.80-0.90, storm 0.83-0.93, fog 0.88-0.96, snow 0.75-0.88). Clear skies interpolate by sun elevation, night blends moonless to moonlit by moon light, weather blends over the clear state by intensity in daylight.
